author: Mark Atwood
text: Codereview pass-3 (edge, kimi-k3) of 2ehk adds impact evidence: the guards loop runs for weeks; if $STATE vanishes mid-run (tmp cleaner, manual cleanup), _write_baseline crashes every cycle -> empty WASTE -> WARN spam and evaluation never resumes until script restart — unrecoverable in place. Fix suggestion: os.makedirs(state_dir, exist_ok=True) in _write_baseline before writing (or mkdir -p "$STATE" inside the loop).
